extras.heading: Practical Interview Quiz – Accessibility Knowledge Check
extras.body:
ఈ 5 questions‌కు సమాధానాలు select చేసి మీ understanding‌ను పరీక్షించుకోండి.

1. Which guideline defines technical web accessibility requirements? (ADA / WCAG / ISO 9001)
2. Which WCAG level is a common accessibility target for many digital products? (Level A / Level AA / Level AAA)
3. Which attribute provides an accessible name for a button? (aria-label / alt / margin)
4. Which technique helps users navigate without a mouse? (Color palette / Keyboard Navigation / Illustration)
5. What is the main purpose of an Accessibility Audit? (Improve brand colors / Evaluate accessibility barriers and conformance / Increase animations)

### Answer key · జవాబులు
1. WCAG · 2. Level AA · 3. aria-label · 4. Keyboard Navigation · 5. Evaluate accessibility barriers and conformance

title: Product Design & Development
subtitle: Product Design మరియు Development
description:
ఈ గ్రూప్‌లో Product Design, Product Management, Agile Development, MVP, Scrum, Technical Concepts, Design Handoff వంటి ముఖ్యమైన అంశాలను నేర్చుకుందాం. Senior UX Designer, Lead Product Designer, Principal Designer, Product Design Manager ఇంటర్వ్యూలలో ఈ concepts చాలా ముఖ్యమైనవి. ముఖ్యంగా Product Managers, Developers, QA Teams‌తో ఎలా collaborate చేయాలో అర్థం చేసుకోవడానికి ఇవి ఉపయోగపడతాయి.

15 comparisons · Q116–Q130.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between Product Design and UX Design?
questions.questionTelugu: Product Design మరియు UX Design మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
Product Design:

ఒక digital product‌ను business goals, user needs, technology constraints ఆధారంగా end-to-endగా రూపొందించే విస్తృతమైన discipline.
ఇందులో UX Research, UX Design, UI Design, Product Strategy, Interaction Design, Business Alignment ఉంటాయి.

UX Design:

యూజర్ అవసరాలు, ప్రవర్తన, సమస్యలను అర్థం చేసుకొని usable, accessible, meaningful experiences రూపొందించడం.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
Product Design vs UX Design

Product Design	UX Design
విస్తృత product discipline	User experience discipline
User + Business + Technology	User అవసరాలు, usability
Product strategy, అమలు	Research, flows, interactions
End-to-end product ఆలోచన	Experience పై దృష్టి పెట్టిన సమస్య పరిష్కారం
Business ఫలితాలు	User experience ఫలితాలు

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"Product Design takes a holistic approach by balancing user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility. UX Design focuses specifically on creating effective and meaningful user experiences. UX is a critical part of Product Design."

తెలుగు అర్థం: Product Design user, business, technology మూడింటినీ సమతుల్యం చేస్తుంది; UX Design user experience పై దృష్టి పెడుతుంది – UX, Product Design లో కీలక భాగం.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- Product Design: Product Design is a holistic discipline that combines user experience, business objectives, and technical feasibility to create successful products.
- UX Design: UX Design focuses on understanding user needs and creating effective, efficient, and satisfying user experiences.

### Key Differences
Product Design vs UX Design

Product Design	UX Design
Broader product discipline	User experience discipline
User + Business + Technology	User needs and usability
Product strategy and execution	Research, flows and interactions
End-to-end product thinking	Experience-focused problem-solving
Business outcomes	User experience outcomes

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"Product Design takes a holistic approach by balancing user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility. UX Design focuses specifically on creating effective and meaningful user experiences. UX is a critical part of Product Design."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Banking App:

Product Designer:
- Customer needs అర్థం చేసుకోవడం.
- Business goals గుర్తించడం.
- Money transfer feature scope నిర్ణయించడం.
- UX/UI design మరియు development teams‌తో కలిసి పని చేయడం.

UX Designer:
- Money transfer user journey.
- User flows.
- Wireframes.
- Usability testing.
- Interaction improvements.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Banking App:

Product Designer:
- Understands customer needs.
- Identifies business goals.
- Decides the scope of the money-transfer feature.
- Works with the UX/UI design and development teams.

UX Designer:
- Money transfer user journey.
- User flows.
- Wireframes.
- Usability testing.
- Interaction improvements.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between Product Manager and Product Designer?
questions.questionTelugu: Product Manager మరియు Product Designer మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
Product Manager (PM):

Product ఏమి నిర్మించాలి, ఎందుకు నిర్మించాలి, ఎప్పుడు విడుదల చేయాలి అనే అంశాలను business strategy, customer needs, market opportunities ఆధారంగా నిర్ణయిస్తారు.

Product Designer:

Product‌ను యూజర్లు ఎలా ఉపయోగించాలి, వారి సమస్యలను ఎలా పరిష్కరించాలి, experience ఎలా ఉండాలి అనే అంశాలను design చేస్తారు.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
Product Manager vs Product Designer

Product Manager	Product Designer
ఏమిటి, ఎందుకు	Experience ఎలా పనిచేస్తుంది
Product strategy	Experience strategy
Roadmap, ప్రాధాన్యతలు	User flows, interaction
Business metrics	Usability, experience metrics
Stakeholders ఏకాభిప్రాయం	Design, users తో ఏకాభిప్రాయం

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"A Product Manager focuses on product strategy, priorities, and business outcomes, while a Product Designer focuses on translating user and business needs into effective product experiences. Both collaborate closely to deliver customer value."

తెలుగు అర్థం: PM strategy, ప్రాధాన్యతలు, business ఫలితాలపై; Product Designer ఆ అవసరాలను మంచి experience గా మార్చడంపై – ఇద్దరూ కలిసి customer value అందిస్తారు.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- Product Manager: A Product Manager defines product strategy, prioritizes opportunities, and aligns stakeholders to deliver business and customer value.
- Product Designer: A Product Designer translates user needs and product requirements into usable, accessible, and valuable experiences.

### Key Differences
Product Manager vs Product Designer

Product Manager	Product Designer
What and Why	How the experience works
Product strategy	Experience strategy
Roadmap & priorities	User flows & interaction
Business metrics	Usability & experience metrics
Stakeholder alignment	Design and user alignment

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"A Product Manager focuses on product strategy, priorities, and business outcomes, while a Product Designer focuses on translating user and business needs into effective product experiences. Both collaborate closely to deliver customer value."
questions.exampleTelugu:
E-commerce App:

Product Manager: Cart abandonment తగ్గించడానికి checkout improvements అవసరమని నిర్ణయిస్తారు.

Product Designer:
- Checkout flow analyze చేస్తారు.
- User pain points identify చేస్తారు.
- Simplified checkout design చేస్తారు.
- Prototype test చేస్తారు.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – E-commerce App:

Product Manager: decides that checkout improvements are needed to reduce cart abandonment.

Product Designer:
- Analyses the checkout flow.
- Identifies user pain points.
- Designs a simplified checkout.
- Tests the prototype.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between Product Discovery and Product Delivery?
questions.questionTelugu: Product Discovery మరియు Product Delivery మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
Product Discovery:

ఏ సమస్యను పరిష్కరించాలి, ఎవరికి పరిష్కరించాలి, ఏ solution ఎక్కువ విలువ ఇస్తుంది అనే విషయాలను research మరియు experimentation ద్వారా తెలుసుకోవడం.

Product Delivery:

Validated solution‌ను design, development, testing ద్వారా working product‌గా తయారు చేసి users‌కు అందించడం.

!fig:assets/images/vs/g9-product-workflow.svg|Product workflow: Discovery (Research, Problem Definition, Ideation, Validation), Delivery (Design, Development, QA, Release), Continuous Learning (Analytics, Feedback, Improvements)|Typical Product Workflow – Discovery → Delivery → Continuous Learning, మళ్లీ Discovery కు.|Typical product workflow: Discovery → Delivery → Continuous Learning, feeding back into Discovery.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
Product Discovery vs Product Delivery

Product Discovery	Product Delivery
సరైన సమస్యను కనుగొనడం	సరైన solution నిర్మించడం
Research, validation	Development, testing
Prototypes, experiments	Working product
అనిశ్చితిని తగ్గించడం	Product విలువ అందించడం
నేర్చుకుని నిర్ణయించడం	నిర్మించి విడుదల చేయడం

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"Product Discovery helps teams identify and validate the right problems and solutions, while Product Delivery focuses on building and releasing those validated solutions. Both activities are continuous and often overlap in modern product teams."

తెలుగు అర్థం: Discovery సరైన సమస్య, solution ను validate చేస్తుంది; Delivery వాటిని నిర్మించి విడుదల చేస్తుంది – ఆధునిక teams లో రెండూ నిరంతరం, కలిసి జరుగుతాయి.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- Product Discovery: Product Discovery identifies the right problems and validates potential solutions before significant development investment.
- Product Delivery: Product Delivery is the process of building, testing, and releasing a product or feature.
- Typical product workflow: Discovery (Research → Problem Definition → Ideation → Validation) → Delivery (Design → Development → QA → Release) → Continuous Learning (Analytics → Feedback → Improvements).

### Key Differences
Product Discovery vs Product Delivery

Product Discovery	Product Delivery
Find the right problem	Build the right solution
Research & validation	Development & testing
Prototypes & experiments	Working product
Reduce uncertainty	Deliver product value
Learn and decide	Build and release

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"Product Discovery helps teams identify and validate the right problems and solutions, while Product Delivery focuses on building and releasing those validated solutions. Both activities are continuous and often overlap in modern product teams."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Money Transfer Feature:

Discovery:
- Users‌కు money transfer‌లో ఏ సమస్యలు ఉన్నాయి?
- User interviews నిర్వహించడం.
- Competitor analysis.
- Prototype testing.

Delivery:
- Final UI design.
- Developer handoff.
- API integration.
- QA testing.
- Production release.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Money Transfer Feature:

Discovery:
- What problems do users have with money transfer?
- Conducting user interviews.
- Competitor analysis.
- Prototype testing.

Delivery:
- Final UI design.
- Developer handoff.
- API integration.
- QA testing.
- Production release.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between MVP and Prototype?
questions.questionTelugu: MVP మరియు Prototype మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
MVP – Minimum Viable Product:

ఒక product యొక్క core user problem‌ను పరిష్కరించడానికి అవసరమైన కనీస ముఖ్యమైన functionalityతో users‌కు release చేసే working product.

Prototype:

ఒక idea లేదా design ఎలా పనిచేస్తుందో simulate చేసి, interactions మరియు assumptions test చేయడానికి రూపొందించే model.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
MVP vs Prototype

MVP	Prototype
పనిచేసే product	Simulate చేసిన product model
ముఖ్యమైన user విలువ అందిస్తుంది	Design assumptions ను test చేస్తుంది
నిజమైన users ఉపయోగించగలరు	Test participants ఉపయోగిస్తారు
Market కు విడుదల కావచ్చు	సాధారణంగా విడుదలకు ముందే
నిజమైన వాడకం feedback	Concept, interaction feedback

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"A Prototype is used to test and validate an idea or interaction, whereas an MVP is a working product with essential functionality that delivers real value to users and helps validate the product in the market."

తెలుగు అర్థం: Prototype idea లేదా interaction ను test చేయడానికి; MVP నిజమైన users కు విలువ ఇచ్చే, market లో validate చేసే పనిచేసే product.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- MVP: An MVP is the smallest usable version of a product that delivers core value and enables teams to learn from real users.
- Prototype: A Prototype is an early representation of a product used to explore, demonstrate, and test concepts before full development.

### Key Differences
MVP vs Prototype

MVP	Prototype
Working product	Simulated product model
Delivers core user value	Tests design assumptions
Real users can use it	Test participants interact with it
May be released to market	Usually used before release
Real usage feedback	Concept and interaction feedback

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"A Prototype is used to test and validate an idea or interaction, whereas an MVP is a working product with essential functionality that delivers real value to users and helps validate the product in the market."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Food Delivery App:

!fig:assets/images/vs/g9-prototype-mvp.svg|Prototype phone with clickable Restaurants, Menu, Cart, Checkout screens next to an MVP phone with real listings, ordering, payment and tracking|Prototype – simulate చేసిన screens; MVP – నిజమైన users ఉపయోగించే పనిచేసే core product.|Prototype: simulated screens. MVP: a working core product used by real users.

Prototype:
- Restaurant selection.
- Menu browsing.
- Cart interaction.
- Simulated checkout.

MVP:
- నిజమైన restaurant listings.
- నిజంగా order చేయడం.
- Payment integration.
- Basic order tracking.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Food Delivery App:

!fig:assets/images/vs/g9-prototype-mvp.svg|Prototype vs MVP phones||Prototype: simulated screens. MVP: a working core product used by real users.

Prototype:
- Restaurant selection.
- Menu browsing.
- Cart interaction.
- Simulated checkout.

MVP:
- Real restaurant listings.
- Actual ordering.
- Payment integration.
- Basic order tracking.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between MVP and MLP (Minimum Lovable Product)?
questions.questionTelugu: MVP మరియు MLP (Minimum Lovable Product) మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
MVP – Minimum Viable Product:

Core problem‌ను పరిష్కరించడానికి అవసరమైన minimum functionality అందించడం.

MLP – Minimum Lovable Product:

Core functionalityతో పాటు users‌కు మంచి experience, emotional connection, satisfaction కలిగించే minimum product experience‌ను అందించడం.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
MVP vs MLP (Minimum Lovable Product)

MVP	MLP
కనీస viable functionality	కనీస lovable experience
ముఖ్య విలువపై దృష్టి	విలువ + ఆనందంపై దృష్టి
Assumptions validate చేయడం	సంతృప్తి, అనుబంధం పెంచడం
సాధారణం కానీ ఉపయోగించగలిగేది	మెరుగుపెట్టిన, ఆకట్టుకునేది
వాడకం నుండి నేర్చుకోవడం	Engagement, loyalty ప్రోత్సహించడం

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"An MVP focuses on delivering the minimum functionality required to validate a product idea, while an MLP adds thoughtful experience elements that make the product more engaging and enjoyable. The goal is to balance essential functionality with user satisfaction."

తెలుగు అర్థం: MVP idea ను validate చేసే కనీస functionality; MLP దానికి ఆకట్టుకునే experience జోడిస్తుంది – ముఖ్య functionality మరియు user సంతృప్తి మధ్య సమతుల్యం లక్ష్యం.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- MVP: The minimum product that delivers essential value.
- MLP: The minimum product designed to deliver essential value along with a delightful and memorable user experience.

### Key Differences
MVP vs MLP (Minimum Lovable Product)

MVP	MLP
Minimum viable functionality	Minimum lovable experience
Focus on core value	Focus on value + delight
Validate assumptions	Build satisfaction and affinity
Basic but usable	Polished and engaging
Learn from usage	Encourage engagement and loyalty

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"An MVP focuses on delivering the minimum functionality required to validate a product idea, while an MLP adds thoughtful experience elements that make the product more engaging and enjoyable. The goal is to balance essential functionality with user satisfaction."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Learning App:

MVP:
- User registration.
- Course listing.
- Video lessons.
- Basic progress tracking.

MLP:
- Personalized learning journey.
- Friendly feedback.
- Progress celebrations.
- Clear learning milestones.
- Smooth and accessible interface.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Learning App:

MVP:
- User registration.
- Course listing.
- Video lessons.
- Basic progress tracking.

MLP:
- Personalized learning journey.
- Friendly feedback.
- Progress celebrations.
- Clear learning milestones.
- Smooth and accessible interface.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between Agile and Waterfall?
questions.questionTelugu: Agile మరియు Waterfall మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
Agile:

Product‌ను చిన్న iterations‌లో develop చేస్తూ, continuous feedback ఆధారంగా improvements చేయడం.

Waterfall:

Project‌ను sequential phases‌గా విభజించి, ఒక phase పూర్తయిన తర్వాత తదుపరి phase‌కు వెళ్లే development approach.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
Agile vs Waterfall

Agile	Waterfall
పునరావృత (iterative)	వరుస క్రమం (sequential)
నిరంతర feedback	Feedback తరచుగా ఆలస్యంగా
సర్దుబాటు చేయగల scope	Scope సాధారణంగా ముందే నిర్ణయం
తరచుగా releases	సాధారణంగా phase ఆధారిత delivery
మార్పులకు సులభంగా సర్దుకుంటుంది	మార్పులు ఎక్కువ ఖర్చు కావచ్చు

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"Agile supports iterative development, continuous feedback, and flexibility, while Waterfall follows a sequential process with predefined phases. Agile is useful when requirements evolve, whereas Waterfall can work well when requirements and delivery constraints are clearly defined."

తెలుగు అర్థం: Requirements మారుతుంటే Agile; requirements, పరిమితులు స్పష్టంగా ఉంటే Waterfall బాగా పనిచేస్తుంది.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- Agile: Agile is an iterative approach to software development that emphasizes collaboration, adaptability, and continuous delivery of value.
- Waterfall: Waterfall is a sequential development approach where each project phase is typically completed before the next begins.

### Key Differences
Agile vs Waterfall

Agile	Waterfall
Iterative	Sequential
Continuous feedback	Feedback often comes later
Flexible scope	Scope generally defined earlier
Frequent releases	Typically phase-based delivery
Adaptable to changes	Changes can be more costly

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"Agile supports iterative development, continuous feedback, and flexibility, while Waterfall follows a sequential process with predefined phases. Agile is useful when requirements evolve, whereas Waterfall can work well when requirements and delivery constraints are clearly defined."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Agile vs Waterfall:

!fig:assets/images/vs/g9-agile-waterfall.svg|Agile cycle of Plan, Design, Build, Test, Release, Feedback around a sprint, next to Waterfall steps Requirements, Design, Development, Testing, Release|Agile – ప్రతి sprint లో పునరావృతమయ్యే cycle; Waterfall – ఒక phase తర్వాత మరొకటి.|Agile repeats a cycle every sprint; Waterfall moves through one phase after another.

- Design phase.
- Development phase.
- Testing phase.
- Final release.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Agile vs Waterfall:

!fig:assets/images/vs/g9-agile-waterfall.svg|Agile cycle vs Waterfall phases||Agile repeats a cycle every sprint; Waterfall moves through one phase after another.

Agile:

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between Scrum and Kanban?
questions.questionTelugu: Scrum మరియు Kanban మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
Scrum:

Agile framework. ఇందులో work‌ను fixed-length iterations అయిన Sprints‌లో organize చేస్తారు.

Common Scrum roles:
- Product Owner
- Scrum Master
- Developers

Common events:
- Sprint Planning
- Daily Scrum
- Sprint Review
- Sprint Retrospective

Kanban:

Work‌ను visual board ద్వారా manage చేస్తూ, workflow‌లో bottlenecks తగ్గించి continuous flow‌ను మెరుగుపరిచే method.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
Scrum vs Kanban

Scrum	Kanban
నిర్ణీత కాల Sprints	నిరంతర ప్రవాహం
Sprint planning	నిరంతర ప్రాధాన్యత నిర్ణయం
నిర్వచించిన బాధ్యతలు	తప్పనిసరి Scrum roles లేవు
Sprint commitment	Work-in-progress పరిమితులు
Sprint review, retrospective	నిరంతర flow మెరుగుదల

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"Scrum organizes work into fixed-length Sprints with defined accountabilities and events, whereas Kanban focuses on continuous workflow management, visualization, and limiting work in progress. Both help teams improve delivery."

తెలుగు అర్థం: Scrum నిర్ణీత కాల Sprints లో పని; Kanban board, WIP limits తో నిరంతర ప్రవాహం – రెండూ delivery ని మెరుగుపరుస్తాయి.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- Scrum: Scrum is an Agile framework that organizes work into time-boxed Sprints with defined accountabilities, events, and artifacts. Roles: Product Owner, Scrum Master, Developers. Events: Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective.
- Kanban: Kanban is a method for managing and improving the flow of work through visualization and work-in-progress limits.

### Key Differences
Scrum vs Kanban

Scrum	Kanban
Fixed-length Sprints	Continuous flow
Sprint planning	Continuous prioritization
Defined accountabilities	No mandatory Scrum roles
Sprint commitment	Work-in-progress limits
Sprint review & retrospective	Continuous flow improvement

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"Scrum organizes work into fixed-length Sprints with defined accountabilities and events, whereas Kanban focuses on continuous workflow management, visualization, and limiting work in progress. Both help teams improve delivery."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Design Team:

!fig:assets/images/vs/g9-scrum-kanban.svg|Scrum sprint events next to a Kanban board with To Do, In Progress, Review and Done columns and WIP limits|Scrum – time-boxed sprint events; Kanban – WIP limits తో నిరంతర work flow.|Scrum: time-boxed sprint events. Kanban: continuous flow with WIP limits.

Scrum:
- రెండు వారాల design sprint.
- Sprint planning.
- Daily stand-up.
- Sprint review.

Kanban:
- To Do → In Progress → Review → Done.
- Priority మరియు అందుబాటులో ఉన్న capacity ఆధారంగా designers tasks ఎంచుకుంటారు.
- Work-in-progress limits bottlenecks ను తగ్గిస్తాయి.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Design Team:

!fig:assets/images/vs/g9-scrum-kanban.svg|Scrum events vs Kanban board||Scrum: time-boxed sprint events. Kanban: continuous flow with WIP limits.

Scrum:
- Two-week design sprint.
- Sprint planning.
- Daily stand-up.
- Sprint review.

Kanban:
- To Do → In Progress → Review → Done.
- Designers pick tasks based on priority and available capacity.
- Work-in-progress limits reduce bottlenecks.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between Design Sprint and Design Thinking?
questions.questionTelugu: Design Sprint మరియు Design Thinking మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
Design Sprint:

ఒక specific product challenge‌ను short, time-boxed process ద్వారా understand చేసి, prototype తయారు చేసి users‌తో test చేసే structured method.
Google Ventures ఐదు రోజుల Design Sprint format‌ను ప్రాచుర్యంలోకి తెచ్చింది.

Design Thinking:

Human-centered problem-solving approach. ఇది users అవసరాలను అర్థం చేసుకొని, ideas generate చేసి, solutions test చేస్తూ problems‌ను పరిష్కరించడంపై దృష్టి పెడుతుంది.

Common five stages:
1. Empathize
2. Define
3. Ideate
4. Prototype
5. Test

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
Design Sprint vs Design Thinking

Design Sprint	Design Thinking
నిర్ణీత కాల పద్ధతి	విస్తృత methodology
తరచుగా ఐదు రోజుల format	నిర్ణీత వ్యవధి లేదు
ఒక నిర్దిష్ట challenge పై దృష్టి	విస్తృత సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించగలదు
నిర్మాణాత్మక activities	పునరావృత సమస్య పరిష్కారం
త్వరగా prototype, test	అర్థం చేసుకోవడం, ideate, iterate

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"Design Thinking is a broader human-centered problem-solving approach, while a Design Sprint is a structured, time-boxed method that helps teams quickly prototype and test a solution to a specific challenge."

తెలుగు అర్థం: Design Thinking విస్తృత human-centered విధానం; Design Sprint ఒక నిర్దిష్ట challenge కు త్వరగా prototype చేసి test చేసే time-boxed పద్ధతి.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- Design Sprint: A Design Sprint is a time-boxed process for understanding a challenge, exploring solutions, prototyping, and testing with users. Google Ventures popularized a five-day Design Sprint format.
- Design Thinking: Design Thinking is a human-centered, iterative approach to solving problems through empathy, ideation, experimentation, and testing. Common stages: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test.

### Key Differences
Design Sprint vs Design Thinking

Design Sprint	Design Thinking
Time-boxed method	Broader methodology
Often five-day format	No fixed duration
Focuses on specific challenge	Can address broad problems
Structured activities	Iterative problem-solving
Prototype and test quickly	Understand, ideate and iterate

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"Design Thinking is a broader human-centered problem-solving approach, while a Design Sprint is a structured, time-boxed method that helps teams quickly prototype and test a solution to a specific challenge."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Banking App:

!fig:assets/images/vs/g9-sprint-thinking.svg|Design Sprint days Monday Map to Friday Test, and Design Thinking stages Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test with an iteration loop|Design Sprint – ఐదు రోజుల format; Design Thinking – ఏ దశకైనా తిరిగి వెళ్లగల ఐదు దశలు.|Design Sprint: a five-day format. Design Thinking: five stages you can loop back through.

Design Thinking:
- Users money transfers ను ఎందుకు మధ్యలో వదిలేస్తున్నారో అర్థం చేసుకోవడం.
- ముఖ్యమైన problems ను define చేయడం.
- Solutions explore చేయడం.
- Prototype చేసి test చేయడం.

Design Sprint:
- ఒక నిర్దిష్ట money transfer challenge పై focused workshop నిర్వహించడం.
- వేర్వేరు solutions sketch చేయడం.
- ఒక solution ఎంచుకోవడం.
- Prototype తయారు చేయడం.
- తక్కువ సమయంలో users తో test చేయడం.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Banking App:

!fig:assets/images/vs/g9-sprint-thinking.svg|Design Sprint days vs Design Thinking stages||Design Sprint: a five-day format. Design Thinking: five stages you can loop back through.

Design Thinking:
- Understand why users abandon money transfers.
- Define key problems.
- Explore solutions.
- Prototype and test.

Design Sprint:
- Conduct a focused workshop around a specific money transfer challenge.
- Sketch alternative solutions.
- Select one solution.
- Build a prototype.
- Test with users within a short period.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between Frontend and Backend?
questions.questionTelugu: Frontend మరియు Backend మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
Frontend Development:

యూజర్‌కు కనిపించే interface‌ను develop చేయడం.

ఉదాహరణలు:
- Buttons
- Forms
- Navigation
- Responsive layouts
- Animations

Backend Development:

Server-side logic, databases, APIs, authentication, business rules వంటి అంశాలను develop చేయడం.

!fig:assets/images/vs/g9-frontend-backend.svg|Client side with browser and presentation layer exchanging API requests and JSON responses with a server side of business logic, data layer and authentication services|Frontend (client side) API request పంపుతుంది; Backend (server side) logic, data ద్వారా JSON response ఇస్తుంది.|The frontend (client side) sends API requests; the backend (server side) responds with JSON from its logic and data.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
Frontend vs Backend

Frontend	Backend
User కు కనిపించేది	Server వైపు
UI, interactions	Business logic
HTML, CSS, JavaScript	Server languages, databases
Browser / app interface	Server, data layer
దృశ్య అమలు	Data, system operations

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"Frontend development implements the user-facing interface and interactions, while Backend development manages server-side logic, databases, authentication, and APIs. Designers collaborate closely with frontend developers to ensure accurate design implementation."

తెలుగు అర్థం: Frontend user కు కనిపించే interface; Backend server logic, databases, APIs – design సరిగ్గా అమలవ్వడానికి designers frontend developers తో దగ్గరగా పనిచేస్తారు.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- Frontend Development: Frontend Development focuses on implementing the user-facing interface and interactions of a digital product. Examples: buttons, forms, navigation, responsive layouts, animations.
- Backend Development: Backend Development handles server-side processing, data management, business logic, and communication with other systems.

### Key Differences
Frontend vs Backend

Frontend	Backend
User-facing	Server-side
UI and interactions	Business logic
HTML, CSS, JavaScript	Server languages and databases
Browser / app interface	Server and data layer
Visual implementation	Data and system operations

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"Frontend development implements the user-facing interface and interactions, while Backend development manages server-side logic, databases, authentication, and APIs. Designers collaborate closely with frontend developers to ensure accurate design implementation."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Login Screen:

Frontend:
- Username field.
- Password field.
- Login button.
- Error message design.

Backend:
- Credentials validate చేయడం.
- User identity verify చేయడం.
- Database కు connect అవ్వడం.
- Authentication response generate చేయడం.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Login Screen:

Frontend:
- Username field.
- Password field.
- Login button.
- Error message design.

Backend:
- Validate credentials.
- Verify user identity.
- Connect to database.
- Generate authentication response.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between API and SDK?
questions.questionTelugu: API మరియు SDK మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
API – Application Programming Interface:

రెండు software systems మధ్య communication చేయడానికి ఉపయోగించే defined interface లేదా set of rules.

SDK – Software Development Kit:

ఒక platform లేదా service కోసం applications develop చేయడానికి అవసరమైన tools, libraries, documentation, and APIs కలిగిన development package.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
API vs SDK

API	SDK
Communication interface	Development toolkit
ఎలా interact చేయాలో నిర్వచిస్తుంది	నిర్మించడానికి tools ఇస్తుంది
Endpoints, methods	Libraries, tools, APIs
స్వతంత్రంగా ఉపయోగించవచ్చు	అనేక APIs ఉండవచ్చు
Systems ను కలుపుతుంది	Development ను సులభం చేస్తుంది

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"An API defines how different software systems communicate, while an SDK provides a broader toolkit for developers, often including APIs, libraries, and documentation to build applications more efficiently."

తెలుగు అర్థం: API systems ఎలా మాట్లాడుకోవాలో నిర్వచిస్తుంది; SDK APIs, libraries, documentation కలిగిన విస్తృత toolkit.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- API: An API defines how software applications communicate and exchange data or functionality.
- SDK: An SDK is a collection of tools, libraries, documentation, and resources that helps developers build applications for a specific platform or service.

### Key Differences
API vs SDK

API	SDK
Communication interface	Development toolkit
Defines how to interact	Provides tools to build
Endpoints and methods	Libraries, tools, APIs
Can be used independently	May include multiple APIs
Connects systems	Simplifies development

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"An API defines how different software systems communicate, while an SDK provides a broader toolkit for developers, often including APIs, libraries, and documentation to build applications more efficiently."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Payment Integration:

API:
- App payment request‌ను payment gateway‌కు పంపుతుంది.
- Payment status response అందుకుంటుంది.

SDK:
- Payment gateway SDK ఉపయోగించి developers payment integration‌ను సులభంగా implement చేస్తారు.
- SDKలో API wrappers, libraries, documentation ఉండవచ్చు.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Payment Integration:

API:
- The app sends the payment request to the payment gateway.
- It receives the payment status response.

SDK:
- Using the payment gateway's SDK, developers implement the payment integration easily.
- The SDK may include API wrappers, libraries and documentation.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between Functional Requirements and Non-functional Requirements?
questions.questionTelugu: Functional Requirements మరియు Non-functional Requirements మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
Functional Requirements:

System ఏమి చేయాలి అనే functionality‌ను వివరిస్తాయి.

ఉదాహరణలు:
- User login.
- Password reset.
- Money transfer.
- Search products.
- Generate reports.

Non-functional Requirements:

System ఎలా పనిచేయాలి, దాని performance, security, reliability, accessibility వంటి quality attributes‌ను వివరిస్తాయి.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
Functional Requirements vs Non-functional Requirements

Functional Requirements	Non-functional Requirements
System ఏమి చేస్తుంది	System ఎంత బాగా పనిచేస్తుంది
Features, ప్రవర్తన	నాణ్యత లక్షణాలు
Login, payments	వేగం, భద్రత
Search, filters	విశ్వసనీయత, scalability
User చర్యలు	Performance పరిమితులు

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"Functional Requirements define what a system should do, such as login, search, and payments. Non-functional Requirements define how well the system should perform, including security, performance, reliability, and accessibility."

తెలుగు అర్థం: Functional – system ఏమి చేయాలి; Non-functional – ఎంత బాగా (security, performance, reliability, accessibility) చేయాలి.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- Functional Requirements: Functional Requirements describe the specific features, behaviors, and operations a system must perform. Examples: user login, password reset, money transfer, search products, generate reports.
- Non-functional Requirements: Non-functional Requirements define quality attributes and constraints such as performance, security, reliability, and accessibility.

### Key Differences
Functional Requirements vs Non-functional Requirements

Functional Requirements	Non-functional Requirements
What system does	How system performs
Features and behavior	Quality attributes
Login and payments	Speed and security
Search and filters	Reliability and scalability
User actions	Performance constraints

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"Functional Requirements define what a system should do, such as login, search, and payments. Non-functional Requirements define how well the system should perform, including security, performance, reliability, and accessibility."
questions.exampleTelugu:
E-commerce App:

Functional:
- User products ను cart కు add చేయగలరు.
- User coupon apply చేయగలరు.
- User order place చేయగలరు.

Non-functional:
- Product page అంగీకరించిన performance targets లోపు load అవుతుంది.
- Payment data సురక్షితంగా handle చేయబడుతుంది.
- Interface accessibility requirements కు మద్దతు ఇస్తుంది.
- System ఆశించిన traffic ను handle చేస్తుంది.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – E-commerce App:

Functional:
- User can add products to cart.
- User can apply coupon.
- User can place an order.

Non-functional:
- Product page loads within agreed performance targets.
- Payment data is securely handled.
- Interface supports accessibility requirements.
- System handles expected traffic.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between User Story and Use Case?
questions.questionTelugu: User Story మరియు Use Case మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
User Story:

ఒక user‌కు ఏ functionality ఎందుకు అవసరమో simple format‌లో వివరిస్తుంది.

Common format:
"As a [user], I want [goal], so that [benefit]."

Use Case:

ఒక user మరియు system మధ్య జరిగే interaction‌ను step-by-stepగా వివరిస్తుంది.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
User Story vs Use Case

User Story	Use Case
చిన్న requirement	వివరమైన interaction సన్నివేశం
User అవసరం, విలువ	Actor-system interaction
సరళమైన format	Main, alternative flows
Agile backlog	System ప్రవర్తన documentation

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"A User Story describes a feature from the user's perspective and highlights its value, while a Use Case provides detailed steps explaining how the user and system interact to achieve a goal."

తెలుగు అర్థం: User Story user దృష్టి నుండి feature, దాని విలువ; Use Case user–system interaction ను step-by-step వివరిస్తుంది.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- User Story: A User Story is a concise description of a feature from the perspective of the user and the value they expect. Format: "As a [user], I want [goal], so that [benefit]."
- Use Case: A Use Case describes how an actor interacts with a system to achieve a specific goal, including possible flows and alternative scenarios.

### Key Differences
User Story vs Use Case

User Story	Use Case
Short requirement	Detailed interaction scenario
User need and value	Actor-system interaction
Simple format	Main and alternative flows
Agile backlog	System behavior documentation

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"A User Story describes a feature from the user's perspective and highlights its value, while a Use Case provides detailed steps explaining how the user and system interact to achieve a goal."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Password Reset:

User Story:
"As a registered user, I want to reset my password so that I can regain access to my account."
(నమోదైన user గా, నా account ను మళ్లీ యాక్సెస్ చేయడానికి password reset చేయాలనుకుంటున్నాను.)

Use Case:
1. User Forgot Password ఎంచుకుంటారు.
2. System నమోదైన email అడుగుతుంది.
3. User email నమోదు చేస్తారు.
4. System verification link లేదా OTP పంపుతుంది.
5. User identity verify చేసుకుంటారు.
6. User కొత్త password సృష్టిస్తారు.
7. System విజయవంతమైన reset ను నిర్ధారిస్తుంది.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Password Reset:

User Story:
"As a registered user, I want to reset my password so that I can regain access to my account."

Use Case:
1. User selects Forgot Password.
2. System requests registered email.
3. User enters email.
4. System sends verification link or OTP.
5. User verifies identity.
6. User creates a new password.
7. System confirms successful reset.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done?
questions.questionTelugu: Acceptance Criteria మరియు Definition of Done మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
Acceptance Criteria:

ఒక specific feature లేదా user story ఎప్పుడు acceptable‌గా పరిగణించాలో తెలిపే conditions.

Definition of Done (DoD):

ఒక task, feature, లేదా increment పూర్తయిందని team అంగీకరించడానికి వర్తించే shared quality standards.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
Acceptance Criteria vs Definition of Done

Acceptance Criteria	Definition of Done
Feature కు ప్రత్యేకం	Team మొత్తానికి నాణ్యత ప్రమాణం
ఆశించిన ప్రవర్తనను నిర్వచిస్తుంది	పూర్తి నాణ్యతను నిర్వచిస్తుంది
ఒక user story కు వర్తిస్తుంది	DoD కి లోబడే అన్ని పనులకు వర్తిస్తుంది
Functional conditions	Testing, review, documentation మొదలైనవి

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"Acceptance Criteria define the specific conditions a feature must satisfy, whereas Definition of Done establishes the shared quality standards required for a deliverable to be considered complete."

తెలుగు అర్థం: Acceptance Criteria ఒక feature కు ప్రత్యేక షరతులు; Definition of Done పని పూర్తయిందని చెప్పడానికి team మొత్తం పాటించే నాణ్యత ప్రమాణాలు.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- Acceptance Criteria: Acceptance Criteria are specific conditions that a feature or user story must satisfy to be accepted.
- Definition of Done: Definition of Done is a shared set of quality criteria that work must satisfy before it is considered complete.

### Key Differences
Acceptance Criteria vs Definition of Done

Acceptance Criteria	Definition of Done
Feature-specific	Team-wide quality standard
Defines expected behavior	Defines completion quality
Applies to a user story	Applies to work meeting DoD
Functional conditions	Testing, review, documentation, etc.

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"Acceptance Criteria define the specific conditions a feature must satisfy, whereas Definition of Done establishes the shared quality standards required for a deliverable to be considered complete."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Login Feature:

Acceptance Criteria:
- సరైన credentials తో login అవుతుంది.
- తప్పు password ఇస్తే error చూపిస్తుంది.
- Forgot Password link పనిచేస్తుంది.
- ఖాళీ fields కు validation చూపిస్తుంది.

Definition of Done:
- Code review పూర్తయింది.
- అవసరమైన tests pass అయ్యాయి.
- Accessibility checks పూర్తయ్యాయి.
- Design implementation review అయింది.
- అవసరమైన చోట documentation update అయింది.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Login Feature:

Acceptance Criteria:
- Valid credentials allow login.
- Invalid password displays an error.
- Forgot Password link works.
- Empty fields show validation.

Definition of Done:
- Code reviewed.
- Required tests passed.
- Accessibility checks completed.
- Design implementation reviewed.
- Documentation updated, where required.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between Design Handoff and Developer Handoff?
questions.questionTelugu: Design Handoff మరియు Developer Handoff మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
ఈ రెండు terms చాలా సందర్భాల్లో interchangeable‌గా వాడతారు. కానీ ఈ guideలో వీటి scope‌ను ఇలా అర్థం చేసుకుందాం.

Design Handoff:

Approved design files, interaction details, assets, responsive behavior, and specifications‌ను implementation team‌కు అందించడం.

Developer Handoff:

Developers‌కు implementation కోసం అవసరమైన design information, technical specifications, component details, edge cases, and assets అందించడం.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
Design Handoff vs Developer Handoff

Design Handoff	Developer Handoff
Design సమాచారాన్ని విస్తృతంగా అందించడం	Developers కోసం implementation వివరాలు
Screens, prototypes	Specs, component ప్రవర్తన
Design assets	Export చేయగల assets, technical వివరాలు
Interaction documentation	States, validations, edge cases
Teams మధ్య ఏకాభిప్రాయం	అమలుకు సిద్ధంగా ఉండటం

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"Design Handoff communicates the approved design and interaction specifications to the team, while Developer Handoff provides implementation-ready details such as component behavior, dimensions, assets, states, and responsive rules. The goal is to reduce ambiguity and ensure design fidelity."

తెలుగు అర్థం: Design Handoff approve అయిన design ను team కు అందిస్తుంది; Developer Handoff అమలుకు సిద్ధమైన వివరాలు ఇస్తుంది – లక్ష్యం: అస్పష్టత తగ్గించి design fidelity నిలపడం.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- Note: The two terms are often used interchangeably; this guide separates their scope as follows.
- Design Handoff: Design Handoff is the process of transferring approved design specifications, assets, and interaction details to the implementation team.
- Developer Handoff: Developer Handoff focuses on providing developers with the technical and design information required to implement the product accurately.

### Key Differences
Design Handoff vs Developer Handoff

Design Handoff	Developer Handoff
Broad transfer of design information	Developer-focused implementation details
Screens and prototypes	Specs and component behavior
Design assets	Exportable assets and technical details
Interaction documentation	States, validations, edge cases
Cross-functional alignment	Implementation readiness

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"Design Handoff communicates the approved design and interaction specifications to the team, while Developer Handoff provides implementation-ready details such as component behavior, dimensions, assets, states, and responsive rules. The goal is to reduce ambiguity and ensure design fidelity."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Mobile App:

!fig:assets/images/vs/g9-handoff-redline.svg|Mobile recipe screen with pink spacing redlines and notes for typography, spacing grid, button states, loading and error states and asset exports|Developer Handoff – spacing, sizes, states, assets వంటి redline specs (ఉదాహరణ).|Developer handoff: redline specs for spacing, sizes, states and assets (illustrative).

Design Handoff:
- Approve అయిన Figma screens.
- User flows.
- Interactive prototype.
- Design system references.

Developer Handoff:
- Component dimensions.
- Spacing, typography values.
- Responsive behavior.
- Button states.
- Error, loading states.
- Asset export వివరాలు.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Mobile App:

!fig:assets/images/vs/g9-handoff-redline.svg|Redline specs on a mobile screen||Developer handoff: redline specs for spacing, sizes, states and assets (illustrative).

Design Handoff:
- Approved Figma screens.
- User flows.
- Interactive prototype.
- Design system references.

Developer Handoff:
- Component dimensions.
- Spacing and typography values.
- Responsive behavior.
- Button states.
- Error and loading states.
- Asset export details.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between Design QA and Product QA?
questions.questionTelugu: Design QA మరియు Product QA మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
Design QA – Design Quality Assurance:

Developers implement చేసిన interface approved design specifications‌కు ఎంతవరకు match అవుతుందో check చేయడం.

Product QA – Product Quality Assurance:

Product యొక్క functionality, reliability, performance, security, and overall quality‌ను verify చేయడం.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
Design QA vs Product QA

Design QA	Product QA
దృశ్య, interaction ఖచ్చితత్వం	మొత్తం product నాణ్యత
Design specifications	Functional requirements
Typography, spacing	Feature ప్రవర్తన
Responsive UI	Performance, విశ్వసనీయత
Design స్థిరత్వం	Product సరిగ్గా పనిచేయడం

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"Design QA focuses on visual consistency and interaction fidelity between the approved designs and implemented interface. Product QA validates the overall functionality, reliability, performance, and quality of the product. Both are necessary before release."

తెలుగు అర్థం: Design QA design కు అమలుకు మధ్య దృశ్య ఖచ్చితత్వం; Product QA మొత్తం functionality, నాణ్యత – release కు ముందు రెండూ అవసరం.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- Design QA: Design QA verifies whether the implemented interface matches the approved design in terms of layout, typography, spacing, colors, components, and interactions.
- Product QA: Product QA evaluates whether the product works correctly and meets functional and non-functional quality requirements.

### Key Differences
Design QA vs Product QA

Design QA	Product QA
Visual and interaction accuracy	Overall product quality
Design specifications	Functional requirements
Typography and spacing	Feature behavior
Responsive UI	Performance and reliability
Design consistency	Product correctness

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"Design QA focuses on visual consistency and interaction fidelity between the approved designs and implemented interface. Product QA validates the overall functionality, reliability, performance, and quality of the product. Both are necessary before release."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Banking App:

Design QA:
- Button colors correct‌గా ఉన్నాయా?
- Typography మరియు spacing match అవుతున్నాయా?
- Mobile responsive layout correct‌గా ఉందా?
- Error states design ప్రకారం ఉన్నాయా?

Product QA:
- Login పనిచేస్తుందా?
- Money transfer successful‌గా జరుగుతుందా?
- Invalid transaction handle చేస్తున్నదా?
- Payment data secure‌గా ఉందా?
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Banking App:

Design QA:
- Are the button colours correct?
- Do typography and spacing match?
- Is the mobile responsive layout correct?
- Are the error states as designed?

Product QA:
- Does login work?
- Does the money transfer complete successfully?
- Are invalid transactions handled?
- Is payment data secure?

extras.heading: Practical Interview Quiz – Product Design Knowledge Check
extras.body:
ఈ 5 questions ద్వారా Product Design & Development concepts‌ను పరీక్షించుకోండి.

1. Which activity helps a team validate whether it is solving the right user problem? (Product Delivery / Product Discovery / Product QA)
2. Which is a working product with essential functionality? (Prototype / MVP / Wireframe)
3. Which method uses time-boxed Sprints? (Kanban / Scrum / Waterfall)
4. What defines the conditions a specific feature must satisfy? (Definition of Done / Acceptance Criteria / Design Tokens)
5. Which process checks whether the implemented UI matches approved designs? (Product QA / Design QA / Product Discovery)

### Answer key · జవాబులు
1. Product Discovery · 2. MVP · 3. Scrum · 4. Acceptance Criteria · 5. Design QA

title: UX Metrics & Analytics
subtitle: UX Metrics మరియు Analytics
description:
ఇది మన 142-question UX Interview Preparation Guide‌లో చివరి గ్రూప్. ఈ గ్రూప్‌లో UX Metrics, Product Analytics, User Behavior, Conversion, Retention, A/B Testing వంటి ముఖ్యమైన అంశాలను నేర్చుకుందాం. ఇంటర్వ్యూలలో ఒక ముఖ్యమైన ప్రశ్న: "How do you measure the success of your design?" దీనికి సమాధానం ఇవ్వాలంటే కేవలం మంచి UI Design చూపించడం సరిపోదు; మన design వల్ల user behavior, usability, engagement, conversion, retention లో వచ్చిన మార్పులను metrics ద్వారా అర్థం చేసుకోవాలి.

12 comparisons · Q131–Q142.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between Qualitative Data and Quantitative Data?
questions.questionTelugu: Qualitative Data మరియు Quantitative Data మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
Qualitative Data (గుణాత్మక సమాచారం):

యూజర్లు ఏం ఆలోచిస్తున్నారు, ఎందుకు ఒక సమస్య ఎదుర్కొంటున్నారు, వారి భావాలు మరియు అనుభవాలు ఏమిటి అనే విషయాలను అర్థం చేసుకోవడానికి ఉపయోగించే descriptive information.

ఉదాహరణలు:
- User interviews
- Open-ended survey responses
- Usability testing observations
- Customer feedback

Quantitative Data (పరిమాణాత్మక సమాచారం):

సంఖ్యల రూపంలో కొలవగలిగే information.

ఉదాహరణలు:
- Conversion rate
- Task completion rate
- Number of active users
- Time on task
- Revenue

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
Qualitative Data vs Quantitative Data

Qualitative Data	Quantitative Data
వివరణాత్మకం	సంఖ్యాత్మకం
ఎందుకు, ఎలా అని వివరిస్తుంది	ఎంత, ఎంత తరచుగా అని వివరిస్తుంది
Interviews	Analytics
User పరిశీలనలు	Conversion rates
Open-ended feedback	నిర్మాణాత్మక survey ఫలితాలు

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"Qualitative data helps me understand why users behave in a particular way through interviews, observations, and feedback. Quantitative data helps me measure how frequently or effectively they behave through metrics such as conversion rates, task completion, and engagement. I use both together to make evidence-based design decisions."

తెలుగు అర్థం: Qualitative "ఎందుకు" అని, Quantitative "ఎంత, ఎంత తరచుగా" అని చెబుతుంది – evidence ఆధారిత design నిర్ణయాలకు రెండింటినీ కలిపి ఉపయోగిస్తాను.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- Qualitative Data: Qualitative Data describes users' opinions, motivations, experiences, and behaviors, helping teams understand why something happens. Examples: user interviews, open-ended survey responses, usability testing observations, customer feedback.
- Quantitative Data: Quantitative Data consists of measurable numerical information used to identify patterns, compare performance, and measure outcomes. Examples: conversion rate, task completion rate, number of active users, time on task, revenue.

### Key Differences
Qualitative Data vs Quantitative Data

Qualitative Data	Quantitative Data
Descriptive	Numerical
Explains Why and How	Explains How Much and How Often
Interviews	Analytics
User observations	Conversion rates
Open-ended feedback	Structured survey results

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"Qualitative data helps me understand why users behave in a particular way through interviews, observations, and feedback. Quantitative data helps me measure how frequently or effectively they behave through metrics such as conversion rates, task completion, and engagement. I use both together to make evidence-based design decisions."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Classic Rummy:

Qualitative:
- Users‌కు game table navigation confusing‌గా ఉందని feedback వచ్చింది.
- New users‌కు rules అర్థం కావడం లేదని usability testing‌లో గుర్తించారు.

Quantitative:
- 35% users tutorial మధ్యలో exit అవుతున్నారు.
- Tutorial completion rate 65% ఉంది.
- మొదటి game ప్రారంభించడానికి సగటు సమయం 3 నిమిషాలు.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Classic Rummy:

Qualitative:
- Feedback said that game-table navigation is confusing.
- Usability testing found that new users don't understand the rules.

Quantitative:
- 35% of users exit midway through the tutorial.
- Tutorial completion rate is 65%.
- Average time to start the first game: 3 minutes.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between KPI and UX Metrics?
questions.questionTelugu: KPI మరియు UX Metrics మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
KPI – Key Performance Indicator:

ఒక business లేదా product యొక్క ముఖ్యమైన objectives సాధిస్తున్నామా లేదా అనేది measure చేసే key metric.

ఉదాహరణలు:
- Revenue growth
- Customer acquisition
- Subscription conversion
- Customer retention

UX Metrics:

ఒక product‌ను యూజర్లు ఎంత సులభంగా, సమర్థవంతంగా, సంతృప్తికరంగా ఉపయోగిస్తున్నారో measure చేసే metrics.

Important: కొన్ని UX metrics కూడా business KPIs‌గా ఉపయోగించవచ్చు. ఇవి పూర్తిగా వేర్వేరు categories కావు.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
KPI vs UX Metrics

KPI	UX Metrics
Business పనితీరు సూచిక	User experience కొలత
ఆదాయం, వృద్ధి	Task విజయం, usability
Business లక్ష్యాలు	User కేంద్రిత లక్ష్యాలు
Conversion, retention	SUS, CSAT, task completion
వ్యూహాత్మక కొలత	Experience మూల్యాంకనం

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"KPIs measure progress toward key business objectives, while UX metrics evaluate how effectively users interact with a product. I connect UX metrics with business KPIs to understand how improvements in user experience contribute to product success."

తెలుగు అర్థం: KPIs business లక్ష్యాల పురోగతిని, UX metrics user experience నాణ్యతను కొలుస్తాయి – రెండింటినీ కలిపి UX మెరుగుదల product విజయానికి ఎలా తోడ్పడిందో చూపిస్తాను.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- KPI: A KPI is a measurable indicator used to evaluate progress toward important business or organizational objectives. Examples: revenue growth, customer acquisition, subscription conversion, customer retention.
- UX Metrics: UX Metrics measure the quality of user experiences, including usability, satisfaction, efficiency, and engagement.
- Important: Some UX metrics can also be used as business KPIs – they are not completely separate categories.

### Key Differences
KPI vs UX Metrics

KPI	UX Metrics
Business performance indicator	User experience measurement
Revenue and growth	Task success and usability
Business objectives	User-centered objectives
Conversion and retention	SUS, CSAT, task completion
Strategic measurement	Experience evaluation

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"KPIs measure progress toward key business objectives, while UX metrics evaluate how effectively users interact with a product. I connect UX metrics with business KPIs to understand how improvements in user experience contribute to product success."
questions.exampleTelugu:
E-commerce:

Business KPI:
- Purchase conversion rate ను 10% పెంచడం.

UX Metrics:
- Checkout task completion rate.
- Checkout పూర్తి చేయడానికి సగటు సమయం.
- Checkout error rate.
- Customer satisfaction.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – E-commerce:

Business KPI:
- Increase purchase conversion rate by 10%.

UX Metrics:
- Checkout task completion rate.
- Average time to complete checkout.
- Checkout error rate.
- Customer satisfaction.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between DAU and MAU?
questions.questionTelugu: DAU మరియు MAU మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
DAU – Daily Active Users:

ఒక రోజులో product‌ను meaningful‌గా ఉపయోగించిన unique users సంఖ్య.

MAU – Monthly Active Users:

ఒక నెలలో product‌ను meaningful‌గా ఉపయోగించిన unique users సంఖ్య.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
DAU vs MAU

DAU	MAU
రోజువారీ active users	నెలవారీ active users
రోజువారీ engagement	నెలవారీ engagement
స్వల్పకాల వాడకం	దీర్ఘకాల వాడకం
రోజువారీ product activity	నెలవారీ product activity

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"DAU measures the number of unique active users in a day, whereas MAU measures unique active users over a month. Together, they help evaluate product engagement and usage patterns. The definition of an active user should be based on meaningful product activity."

తెలుగు అర్థం: DAU రోజుకు, MAU నెలకు unique active users – "active user" నిర్వచనం అర్థవంతమైన product activity ఆధారంగా ఉండాలి.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- DAU: DAU measures the number of unique active users within a single day.
- MAU: MAU measures the number of unique active users within a month.

### Key Differences
DAU vs MAU

DAU	MAU
Daily active users	Monthly active users
Daily engagement	Monthly engagement
Short-term usage	Longer-term usage
Daily product activity	Monthly product activity

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"DAU measures the number of unique active users in a day, whereas MAU measures unique active users over a month. Together, they help evaluate product engagement and usage patterns. The definition of an active user should be based on meaningful product activity."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Learning App:

!fig:assets/images/vs/g10-dau-mau.svg|Bar chart of daily active users peaking at 5,500 on Tuesday next to a monthly active users total of 40,000|ఉదాహరణ (illustrative): DAU – ప్రతి రోజు unique users; MAU – నెలలో కనీసం ఒకసారి active అయిన unique users.|Illustrative: DAU counts unique users per day; MAU counts unique users active at least once in the month.

ఒక learning app‌లో:
- Monday active users = 5,000
- Tuesday active users = 5,500
- Monthly unique active users = 40,000

ఇక్కడ DAU అనేది ఒక్కో రోజు unique active users‌ను కొలుస్తుంది. MAU అనేది మొత్తం నెలలో కనీసం ఒకసారి active అయిన unique users‌ను కొలుస్తుంది.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Learning App:

!fig:assets/images/vs/g10-dau-mau.svg|DAU bars vs MAU total||Illustrative: DAU counts unique users per day; MAU counts unique users active at least once in the month.

In a learning app:
- Monday active users = 5,000
- Tuesday active users = 5,500
- Monthly unique active users = 40,000

DAU counts the unique active users on each day. MAU counts the unique users who were active at least once during the whole month.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between Conversion Rate and Retention Rate?
questions.questionTelugu: Conversion Rate మరియు Retention Rate మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
Conversion Rate:

ఒక specific desired action పూర్తి చేసిన users percentage.

Formula:
Conversion Rate = (Conversions ÷ Eligible Users) × 100

Retention Rate:

ఒక నిర్దిష్ట కాలం తర్వాత కూడా product‌ను ఉపయోగిస్తున్న users percentage.

Cohort-based formula:
Retention Rate = (Users from Original Cohort Active at Time t ÷ Original Cohort Users) × 100

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
Conversion Rate vs Retention Rate

Conversion Rate	Retention Rate
కోరిన చర్య పూర్తి చేయడం	Product ను కొనసాగించి ఉపయోగించడం
Purchase, signup, subscription	తిరిగి వచ్చే users
Acquisition funnel ఫలితాలను కొలుస్తుంది	కొనసాగే engagement ను కొలుస్తుంది
స్వల్పకాల లేదా event ఆధారితం	కాల ఆధారితం

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"Conversion Rate measures how many users complete a specific desired action, such as signing up or making a purchase. Retention Rate measures how many users continue using the product over time. Both are important for understanding product growth and long-term value."

తెలుగు అర్థం: Conversion – ఎంతమంది కోరిన చర్య పూర్తి చేశారు; Retention – ఎంతమంది కాలక్రమంలో కొనసాగుతున్నారు. వృద్ధి, దీర్ఘకాల విలువకు రెండూ ముఖ్యం.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- Conversion Rate: Conversion Rate measures the percentage of users who complete a desired action out of the relevant audience. Formula: (Conversions ÷ Eligible Users) × 100.
- Retention Rate: Retention Rate measures the percentage of users who continue using a product over a defined period. Cohort-based formula: (Users from Original Cohort Active at Time t ÷ Original Cohort Users) × 100.

### Key Differences
Conversion Rate vs Retention Rate

Conversion Rate	Retention Rate
Desired action completion	Continued product usage
Purchase, signup, subscription	Returning users
Measures acquisition funnel outcomes	Measures ongoing engagement
Short-term or event-based	Time-based

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"Conversion Rate measures how many users complete a specific desired action, such as signing up or making a purchase. Retention Rate measures how many users continue using the product over time. Both are important for understanding product growth and long-term value."
questions.exampleTelugu:
E-commerce:

Conversion:
- 1,000 users product page ను సందర్శించారు.
- 100 users కొనుగోలు చేశారు.
- Conversion Rate = 10%.

Retention:
- January లో 1,000 users sign up అయ్యారు.
- February లో 300 users తిరిగి వచ్చారు.
- February retention = 30%.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – E-commerce:

Conversion:
- 1,000 users visit the product page.
- 100 users purchase.
- Conversion Rate = 10%.

Retention:
- 1,000 users sign up in January.
- 300 users return in February.
- February retention = 30%.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between Bounce Rate and Exit Rate?
questions.questionTelugu: Bounce Rate మరియు Exit Rate మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
Bounce Rate:

ఒక website‌లో user ఒక page‌ను visit చేసి, meaningful engagement లేదా further navigation లేకుండా session‌ను వదిలిపెట్టిన సందర్భాలను measure చేస్తుంది.
GA4లో Bounce Rate అనేది Engagement Rate‌కు complement. Engaged Session‌గా పరిగణించబడని sessions percentage.

Exit Rate:

ఒక specific page‌ను చివరిగా చూసి users తమ session‌ను ముగించిన percentage.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
Bounce Rate vs Exit Rate

Bounce Rate	Exit Rate
Session స్థాయి భావన	Page స్థాయి భావన
GA4: engage కాని sessions	Session లో చివరి page
Landing page engagement ను అంచనా వేయడానికి	Users ఎక్కడ వెళ్లిపోతున్నారో గుర్తించడానికి
ప్రతి user page ను ఇష్టపడలేదని అర్థం కాదు	Exit ఆశించినదే లేదా సాధారణమే కావచ్చు

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"Bounce Rate in GA4 measures the percentage of sessions that were not engaged, whereas Exit Rate measures how often a particular page is the last page viewed in a session. I interpret both in context rather than assuming a high value always indicates a design problem."

తెలుగు అర్థం: Bounce Rate – engage కాని sessions; Exit Rate – ఒక page session లో చివరిది అయిన శాతం. ఎక్కువ విలువ ఎప్పుడూ design సమస్య కాదు – context లో అర్థం చేసుకోవాలి.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- Bounce Rate: In GA4, Bounce Rate is the percentage of sessions that were not engaged sessions (the complement of Engagement Rate).
- Exit Rate: Exit Rate measures the percentage of page views for a particular page that were the final page views of sessions.

### Key Differences
Bounce Rate vs Exit Rate

Bounce Rate	Exit Rate
Session-level concept	Page-level concept
GA4: Not engaged sessions	Page is last in session
Helps evaluate landing-page engagement	Helps identify where users leave
Does not mean every user disliked the page	Exit can be expected or normal

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"Bounce Rate in GA4 measures the percentage of sessions that were not engaged, whereas Exit Rate measures how often a particular page is the last page viewed in a session. I interpret both in context rather than assuming a high value always indicates a design problem."
questions.exampleTelugu:
E-commerce Website:

Page A – Product Landing Page:
- Users నేరుగా ఈ page కు వస్తారు.
- మరింత engage కాకుండా వెళ్లిపోతారు.
- ఇది Bounce Rate కు కారణం కావచ్చు.

Page B – Order Confirmation:
- Users purchase పూర్తి చేస్తారు.
- Confirmation page చూస్తారు.
- Website నుండి exit అవుతారు.

ఇక్కడ Order Confirmation page‌కు Exit Rate ఎక్కువగా ఉండవచ్చు. కానీ అది తప్పనిసరిగా UX సమస్య కాదు.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – E-commerce Website:

Page A – Product Landing Page:
- Users directly visit this page.
- They leave without engaging further.
- This may contribute to Bounce Rate.

Page B – Order Confirmation:
- Users complete purchase.
- They see confirmation page.
- They exit the website.

Here the Order Confirmation page may have a high Exit Rate, but that is not necessarily a UX problem.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between Task Success Rate and Task Completion Rate?
questions.questionTelugu: Task Success Rate మరియు Task Completion Rate మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
ఈ రెండు terms చాలా సందర్భాల్లో similar meaning‌తో ఉపయోగిస్తారు. అయితే usability evaluationలో వీటి మధ్య useful distinction ఇలా ఉంటుంది.

Task Success Rate:

యూజర్లు ఒక task‌ను predefined success criteria ప్రకారం విజయవంతంగా పూర్తి చేసిన percentage.

Task Completion Rate:

ఒక task‌ను పూర్తిగా finish చేసిన users percentage. కొన్ని testing frameworks‌లో ఇది Task Success Rate‌కు సమానంగా నిర్వచించబడుతుంది.

Formula (binary completion ఉపయోగించినప్పుడు):
Task Completion Rate = (Completed Tasks ÷ Total Attempts) × 100

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
Task Success Rate vs Task Completion Rate

Task Success Rate	Task Completion Rate
Success criteria సాధించడంపై దృష్టి	Task పూర్తి చేయడంపై దృష్టి
సరైన ఫలితాన్ని పరిగణించవచ్చు	పూర్తైన tasks ను కొలుస్తుంది
పాక్షిక / తప్పు ఫలితాలు fail కావచ్చు	నిర్వచించిన completion నియమాలపై ఆధారం
Usability ఫలితం	Task completion ఫలితం

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"Task Success Rate focuses on whether users achieve the intended outcome correctly, while Task Completion Rate focuses on whether they finish the task. In practice, the terms can overlap, so I always define success and completion criteria clearly before testing."

తెలుగు అర్థం: Success – సరైన ఫలితం సాధించారా; Completion – task పూర్తి చేశారా. ఇవి overlap అవుతాయి కాబట్టి testing కు ముందే criteria స్పష్టంగా నిర్వచిస్తాను.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- Note: The two terms are often used with similar meaning; in usability evaluation a useful distinction is as follows.
- Task Success Rate: Task Success Rate measures the percentage of users who successfully achieve a defined task goal.
- Task Completion Rate: Task Completion Rate measures the percentage of users who complete a specified task, with the exact success criteria defined by the study. Formula (binary completion): (Completed Tasks ÷ Total Attempts) × 100.

### Key Differences
Task Success Rate vs Task Completion Rate

Task Success Rate	Task Completion Rate
Focuses on achieving success criteria	Focuses on task completion
May consider correct outcome	Measures completed tasks
Partial or incorrect outcomes may fail	Depends on defined completion rules
Usability outcome	Task completion outcome

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"Task Success Rate focuses on whether users achieve the intended outcome correctly, while Task Completion Rate focuses on whether they finish the task. In practice, the terms can overlap, so I always define success and completion criteria clearly before testing."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Banking App:

Task: ₹5,000 ను మరో account కు transfer చేయడం.
- User A: విజయవంతంగా డబ్బు transfer చేశారు.
- User B: అన్ని steps పూర్తి చేశారు కానీ తప్పు account వివరాలు ఇచ్చారు.
- User C: మధ్యలోనే వదిలేశారు.

Success rate‌ను predefined correct-transfer criteria ఆధారంగా measure చేస్తాం.
Task completion rate‌ను task పూర్తయిందా లేదా అనే study definition ఆధారంగా measure చేస్తాం.
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Banking App:

Task: Transfer ₹5,000 to another account.
- User A: Successfully transfers money.
- User B: Completes all steps but enters incorrect account details.
- User C: Leaves halfway.

Success rate is measured against predefined correct-transfer criteria.
Task completion rate is measured by the study's definition of whether the task was finished.

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between SUS and NPS?
questions.questionTelugu: SUS మరియు NPS మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
SUS – System Usability Scale:

ఒక product లేదా system usability‌ను measure చేయడానికి ఉపయోగించే standardized 10-question questionnaire.
- 10 questions.
- Five-point response scale.
- Score 0 నుండి 100 వరకు.
- ఎక్కువ score సాధారణంగా మెరుగైన perceived usability ని సూచిస్తుంది.

NPS – Net Promoter Score:

ఒక product లేదా service‌ను ఇతరులకు recommend చేసే user willingness‌ను measure చేసే metric.

Question: "How likely are you to recommend this product to a friend or colleague?"
Response: 0–10 scale.
- Detractors: 0–6
- Passives: 7–8
- Promoters: 9–10

NPS = % Promoters − % Detractors

!fig:assets/images/vs/g10-nps.svg|NPS scale from 0 to 10 with detractors 0 to 6, passives 7 to 8 and promoters 9 to 10|NPS scale – Detractors (0–6), Passives (7–8), Promoters (9–10).|NPS scale: Detractors 0–6, Passives 7–8, Promoters 9–10.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
SUS vs NPS

SUS	NPS
గ్రహించిన usability ని కొలుస్తుంది	Recommend చేసే అవకాశాన్ని కొలుస్తుంది
10 ప్రశ్నలు	సాధారణంగా ఒక ప్రధాన ప్రశ్న
Score 0–100	Score -100 నుండి +100
Usability మూల్యాంకనం	Loyalty, advocacy
Product interaction అనుభవం	మొత్తం recommendation భావన

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"SUS is a standardized 10-item questionnaire used to assess perceived system usability, while NPS measures how likely customers are to recommend a product. SUS focuses on usability, whereas NPS focuses on loyalty and advocacy."

తెలుగు అర్థం: SUS – 10 ప్రశ్నలతో usability; NPS – recommend చేసే అవకాశం, అంటే loyalty.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- SUS: SUS is a standardized questionnaire consisting of 10 statements that measures users' perceived usability of a system. 10 questions, five-point scale, score 0–100; higher generally means better perceived usability.
- NPS: NPS measures customer loyalty or advocacy by asking how likely users are to recommend a product or service to others. 0–10 scale: Detractors 0–6, Passives 7–8, Promoters 9–10. NPS = % Promoters − % Detractors.

### Key Differences
SUS vs NPS

SUS	NPS
Measures perceived usability	Measures recommendation likelihood
10 questions	Usually one core question
Score 0–100	Score -100 to +100
Usability evaluation	Loyalty and advocacy
Product interaction experience	Overall recommendation sentiment

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"SUS is a standardized 10-item questionnaire used to assess perceived system usability, while NPS measures how likely customers are to recommend a product. SUS focuses on usability, whereas NPS focuses on loyalty and advocacy."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Design Acharya Learning Platform:

SUS:
- Course navigation easyగా ఉందా?
- Lessons access చేయడం simpleగా ఉందా?
- Students platform ఉపయోగించడంలో confident‌గా ఉన్నారా?

NPS:
- "Would you recommend Design Acharya to another student?"
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Design Acharya Learning Platform:

SUS:
- Is course navigation easy?
- Is accessing lessons simple?
- Are students confident using the platform?

NPS:
- "Would you recommend Design Acharya to another student?"

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between CSAT and CES?
questions.questionTelugu: CSAT మరియు CES మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
CSAT – Customer Satisfaction Score:

ఒక product, service లేదా specific interaction పట్ల user satisfaction‌ను measure చేయడం.
Example question: "How satisfied are you with your experience?"

CES – Customer Effort Score:

ఒక task పూర్తి చేయడానికి user ఎంత effort పెట్టాల్సి వచ్చిందో measure చేయడం.
Example question: "How easy was it to resolve your issue today?"

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
CSAT vs CES

CSAT	CES
సంతృప్తి	శ్రమ (effort)
User ఎంత సంతోషంగా ఉన్నారు?	Task ఎంత సులభంగా ఉంది?
అనుభవ భావనను కొలుస్తుంది	Friction ను కొలుస్తుంది
సంతృప్తి surveys	Effort ఆధారిత surveys

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"CSAT measures how satisfied users are with an experience, while CES measures how much effort users need to complete a task. I use CSAT to understand satisfaction and CES to identify unnecessary friction in user journeys."

తెలుగు అర్థం: CSAT – సంతృప్తి; CES – task కు పట్టిన శ్రమ. CES తో journeys లో అనవసర friction గుర్తిస్తాను.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- CSAT: CSAT measures how satisfied customers are with a product, service, or specific interaction. Example: "How satisfied are you with your experience?"
- CES: CES measures how easy or difficult it was for customers to complete a particular task. Example: "How easy was it to resolve your issue today?"

### Key Differences
CSAT vs CES

CSAT	CES
Satisfaction	Effort
How happy is the user?	How easy was the task?
Measures experience sentiment	Measures friction
Satisfaction surveys	Effort-based surveys

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"CSAT measures how satisfied users are with an experience, while CES measures how much effort users need to complete a task. I use CSAT to understand satisfaction and CES to identify unnecessary friction in user journeys."
questions.exampleTelugu:
Customer Support Platform:

CSAT:
- Support agent response పట్ల customer సంతృప్తిగా ఉన్నారా?

CES:
- Customer తన issue‌ను resolve చేయడానికి ఎన్ని steps తీసుకోవాల్సి వచ్చింది?
- Support ticket submit చేయడం easyగా ఉందా?
questions.exampleEnglish:
Practical Example – Customer Support Platform:

CSAT:
- Is the customer satisfied with the support agent's response?

CES:
- How many steps did the customer need to resolve their issue?
- Was submitting a support ticket easy?

questions.questionEnglish: What is the difference between A/B Testing and Multivariate Testing?
questions.questionTelugu: A/B Testing మరియు Multivariate Testing మధ్య తేడా ఏమిటి?
questions.answerTelugu:
A/B Testing:

ఒక design లేదా experience యొక్క రెండు versions‌ను వేర్వేరు user groups‌కు చూపించి, ఏ version better results ఇస్తుందో statistically evaluate చేయడం.

ఉదాహరణ:
- Version A: Blue CTA button.
- Version B: Green CTA button.

!fig:assets/images/vs/g10-ab-test.svg|Two page versions with a blue Buy Now button and a green Buy Now button, 50/50 traffic split|ఉదాహరణ CTA color experiment – ఇవి నిజమైన test ఫలితాలు కావు.|Illustrative CTA colour experiment, not real test results.

Multivariate Testing (MVT):

ఒకే experiment‌లో multiple design elements యొక్క combinations‌ను పరీక్షించడం.

Important: A/B testing మరియు multivariate testing రెండింటికీ సరైన experiment design, sufficient sample size, statistical analysis అవసరం.

### తేడాలు · Key Differences
A/B Testing vs Multivariate Testing

A/B Testing	Multivariate Testing
Versions ను పోల్చుతుంది	Combinations ను పోల్చుతుంది
సాధారణంగా ఒక ప్రధాన మార్పు	అనేక elements లో మార్పులు
సరళమైన experiment	సంక్లిష్టమైన experiment
చాలా సందర్భాల్లో తక్కువ traffic చాలు	తరచుగా ఎక్కువ traffic అవసరం
మెరుగైన variant ను గుర్తిస్తుంది	Elements మధ్య ప్రభావాన్ని అర్థం చేసుకోవడానికి

### ఇంటర్వ్యూలో ఇలా చెప్పండి · Interview Answer
English లో చెప్పాల్సిన సమాధానం

"A/B Testing compares different versions of a design to identify which performs better, while Multivariate Testing evaluates multiple combinations of design elements to understand their individual and combined impact. I select the method based on the hypothesis, traffic volume, and experiment complexity."

తెలుగు అర్థం: A/B – versions పోలిక; Multivariate – elements combinations పోలిక. Hypothesis, traffic, సంక్లిష్టత ఆధారంగా పద్ధతి ఎంచుకుంటాను.
questions.answerEnglish:
English Definitions:
- A/B Testing: A/B Testing compares two versions of an experience to determine which performs better against a defined metric. Example: Version A – blue CTA button; Version B – green CTA button.
- Multivariate Testing: Multivariate Testing evaluates multiple combinations of changes across different elements to understand their individual and combined effects.
- Important: Both A/B testing and multivariate testing need proper experiment design, a sufficient sample size and statistical analysis.

### Key Differences
A/B Testing vs Multivariate Testing

A/B Testing	Multivariate Testing
Compares versions	Compares combinations
Usually one main variation	Multiple element variations
Simpler experiment	More complex experiment
Lower traffic needs in many cases	Often requires more traffic
Identifies better variant	Helps understand interactions between elements

### Interview Answer
How to say it in an interview

"A/B Testing compares different versions of a design to identify which performs better, while Multivariate Testing evaluates multiple combinations of design elements to understand their individual and combined impact. I select the method based on the hypothesis, traffic volume, and experiment complexity."
questions.exampleTelugu:
E-commerce Checkout:

A/B Testing:
- A: "Continue to Payment"
- B: "Proceed to Pay"

Multivariate Testing:
- Headline: 2 versions.
- CTA color: 2 versions.
- CTA text: 2 versions.

మొత్తం సాధ్యమయ్యే combinations = 2 × 2 × 2 = 8.
questions.exampleEnglish:
